messages:
alex_k: ran a repro on ded cluster with PP=2 TP=4 + remat enabled, seeing perf dip vs no-remat baseline
perf-bot: quick summary: throughput -18%, p99 +22%, nccl_wait up ~3x
maria_g: can you post the exact run config and a short timeline from the profiler?
alex_k: config:
```
model_parallel:
  pipeline_parallel: 2
  tensor_parallel: 4
activation_checkpointing: true
recompute_policy: "remat_every_n"
batching:
  dynamic_batching: true
  max_batch_size: 24
```
alex_k: condensed timeline from trace:
```
0-120ms compute (forward blocks)
120-155ms allreduce (emb/grad sync)
155-220ms recompute (remat)
220-280ms allreduce (tail layers)
280-420ms finalize/backward overhead
```
alex_k: baseline (no remat) looked like:
```
0-160ms compute (longer contiguous compute)
160-200ms allreduce (better overlap)
200-300ms finalize
```
josh_t: looks like remat shifts compute windows and forces more/all of the all-reduces to run without overlap
anita_p: we currently use blocking NCCL collectives on the fast path; async progress is off for these runs
perf-bot: profiler metric: avg_nccl_wait_per_step went from 9ms -> 34ms after enabling remat
maria_g: also noticed a small KV-cache hit-rate drop in chat traces; recompute changes ordering/timing of KV ops so more cache misses
josh_t: combined effect: longer recompute increases time window where all-reduce can't be fully overlapped; plus TP sharding creates smaller allreduce sizes -> more brittle comm granularity\anita_p: quick experiments to try:
- enable NCCL async progress / non-blocking launch
- sweep remat granularity remat_every_n=2..8
- force fused-attn kernels (reduce compute)
- try fp16/integer kernels to tweak compute/comm ratio
alex_k: ran remat_every_n=4 -> throughput improved (recovered ~8%) but still ~-10% vs baseline
alex_k: enabling NCCL async progress + background progress thread dropped nccl_wait to ~12ms and throughput near baseline
maria_g: practical takeaway: remat can harm PP/TP unless runtime ensures comm/compute overlap (async/non-blocking collectives) or we tune remat granularity per topology
josh_t: we should add a microbench that sweeps remat granularity across (PP,TP) grid and reports overlap_ratio, avg_nccl_wait, step_time
anita_p: also add a scheduler hint (recompute_hint) so the orchestrator can prefer aggregation/allreduce placement strategies when remat is on
alex_k: will add microbench and attach traces; also will test with KV-cache pinned/off to separate the cache effect
perf-bot: ticket INF-2091 created and traces uploaded at http://phab/infer/INF-2091\maria_g: please add the microbench results + perf dashboard links to ticket, and assign runtime/comm
alex_k: will post run results tomorrow (~8h sweep)
perf-bot: thread closed; reopen when new traces are uploaded
